findings.title: Administrator browser embedded a bearer-shaped value
Explorer entity endpoint lacked an authorization boundary
Local deployment uses one broad static operator token
findings.rationale: Compose binds API to loopback and is documented as local; managed deployments must add short-lived external identity and scoped capabilities.

findings.title: Container images are version-tagged rather than digest-pinned
findings.rationale: Pin after the first successful container pull records platform-specific multi-architecture digests.

findings.title: Local storage adapters do not enforce at-rest encryption
findings.rationale: Requires deployment KMS and encryption-key lifecycle design; local-only storage policy remains explicit.
